audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[N] read 'Brand' on all seven.
audit.why: packet.levelChart gives Brand every row, 53.73% over 523 games agrees, and every why on the page already argues Brand. Twisted Fate has no sustain, no dash in lane, and a slow-travelling Wild Cards against Brand's 1050-range Sear and 900-range Pillar of Flame.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to Brand across the chart; the content layer was already correct so no win[N] edit was possible.

audit.why: His level 6 is Destiny at 170/140/110s — reveal plus a 1.5-second Gate channel to anywhere on the map. It is a map spike, not a lane spike, and the 170s rank-1 number is what tells you whether a roam is live.
audit.corrected: Added the 170s cooldown to the cooldown field and to the from-behind advice so his roam timer is countable.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls Pillar of Flame Brand's Q, and whys[0] and early call the ability 'Wild Card's' and describe it as short-range harass.
audit.why: Pillar of Flame is W (900 range, 10s at rank 1); Q is Sear, 1050 range, and it only stuns a target already ablaze. Wild Cards is his Q, three cards on a 6/5.75/5.5/5.25/5s cooldown with effectively unlimited range — it is slow-travelling and sidesteppable, not short-range. Pick a Card is a flat 6s at every rank and the gold card is the stun and an attack reset.
audit.corrected: Slot names corrected, Wild Cards renamed and re-described by its travel time, and Pick a Card's flat 6s written into the cooldown field.

audit.why: Pick a Card's flat 6s is the single most useful number in this lane and was missing.
audit.corrected: Pick a Card 6s, Wild Cards 6s, Destiny 170s, Brand's Q 8s and R 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's missingInteractions proposes that Pillar of Flame shuts off Destiny.
audit.why: That comes from a 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' flag on Brand's W, which contradicts Riot's own description — Pillar of Flame creates a damage zone, not terrain, and nothing in the text blocks movement. Per the kit rules the description wins, so I did not write the interaction.
audit.corrected: Not written. Recorded in notes and unverified instead.
sources: ownerKit W text vs ownerKit W flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Two Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Titles promised the stun threat and mid-range positioning; the bodies described the trade combo.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their own titles.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E-Q stun package has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Pick a Card is a flat 6s at every rank: the gold card stuns, so back off the second it glows yellow and step up while he re-rolls. - Wild Cards is 6s at rank 1 and travels slowly enough to sidestep. - Destiny is 170s at rank 1. - Your Q is 8s and needs him ablaze first; your R is 100s.

edits.before: Twisted Fate wins by landing Pick a Card (Gold), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Twisted Fate wins by stunning you with the gold card, farming out of your range, and taking the map with a 170s Destiny.

edits.before: If Twisted Fate takes first blood, tighten up: Pick a Card (Gold) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with W-E clears and stay relevant through stun-burn peel.
edits.after: If Twisted Fate takes first blood he spends it on the map — count his 170s Destiny and ping the roam, not the duel. A second kill means the lane is over and the game isn't: farm with W-E clears and stay relevant as stun-burn peel.

edits.before: Carry through AoE math — no burst mage damages three targets like Brand; your job is the spacing that lets the bounces vote.
edits.after: Carry by punishing Destiny: the Gate channel takes 1.5 seconds and shows you exactly where he lands, so be standing there with Q banked.

edits.before: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt.
edits.after: Sear only stuns a target already ablaze, so E leads — and the standing threat of that stun is what keeps him farming at max range.

edits.before: Twisted Fate whiffs Pick a Card (Gold) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Blaze keeps ticking 4 seconds after your last cast — walk out and let it finish.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: Wild Cards fans three cards and Pick a Card is back every 6s — at half a bar, mid-range is exactly where his whole rotation lands free.

edits.before: Pillar of Flame (Q) into Pillar again through a fully-stacked Ablaze proc punishes TF's slow, card-reliant clear of the wave — you can zone him off cs with just poke.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame (W) into Sear (Q) on the ablaze target punishes TF's slow, card-reliant wave clear — you can zone him off cs with poke alone, and W is back every 10s at rank 1.

edits.before: Level 1: your Q range and Ablaze DoT already outpoke Wild Card's short-range harass, giving you the edge from first recall.
edits.after: Level 1: your 1050-range Q and the Blaze DoT beat Wild Cards, whose three cards travel slowly enough to walk out of.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 already favor you — TF has no reliable way to punish Pillar of Flame poke, and Wild Card's slow travel time means he's rarely landing first hits. By levels 3-5 you're stacking Ablaze for free every time he pushes to farm, and he has to play from max range or concede a chunk of his HP bar every wave.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 already favor you — TF has no reliable way to punish Pillar of Flame poke, and Wild Cards travels slowly enough that he rarely lands the first hit. By levels 3-5 you're stacking Blaze for free every time he pushes to farm, and he has to play from max range or concede a chunk of his HP bar every wave.

notes: The brief's missingInteractions entry ('Your Pillar of Flame (W) shuts off Twisted Fate's Destiny') rests on a terrain flag that contradicts Riot's own text for the ability — Pillar of Flame is a delayed damage zone and creates no terrain, so nothing in it interrupts Gate. I did not write that interaction; it is in unverified. suspectNames flagged 'Gold Card' in spikes[2] and 'Wild Card's' in early: the first is a false positive (the gold Pick a Card is the real thing and the sentence is correct), the second was a genuine name error and is fixed. Full-layer sides said 'Skill' on all seven rows against a content layer and packet chart that both say Brand; sides moved, ratings left alone since the rating tracks stage intensity rather than ownership in this data.
